items.summary: A logarithm answers the question "how many times do I multiply?" It turns wide worlds — from the energy of an earthquake to the loudness of a concert — into numbers a person can hold.
items.title: Logarithms and Log Scales

items.summary: A quadratic equation carries a square of the unknown. One formula reads its roots, and the discriminant tells you how many there are before you compute anything.
items.title: Solving Quadratic Equations
